thesis: The Atlas ML model continues to favor a diverse set of mining stocks, with a strong emphasis on diversified metals and gold. The top picks include Amarc Resources Ltd. (AHR.V), Gold Strike Resources Corp. (GSR.V), and ROYAL GOLD INC (0KXS.L), each boasting high ML scores and promising predicted returns. These positions were opened due to strong ML signals, indicating robust potential for medium-term gains. No short positions are being opened this run as no concrete bearish news was identified on out-of-basket names.
